issues.description: `decideChatRoute()` can still return `farm_query`, but the live dispatch only handles `clarify_route` and `voice_log` before falling through to the advisory block. `handleFarmQuery()` is never called, so deterministic farm-query handling remains unreachable, including after a user answers `2` to the clarification prompt.

The legacy `voice-routing.ts` file still exists in the current tree even though this feature explicitly required replacing it with clean routing/handler modules. Current line counts show `voice-routing.ts` at 1364 lines and `routing/router.ts` at 1406 lines, so the routing refactor is still duplicated and monolithic rather than fully replaced.

The live voice-log path still bypasses `handleVoiceLog()` and only clears `voice_log_draft`. It never persists `voice_log_expected_field` on clarify and never resets `voice_log_expected_field` or `voice_log_clarify_attempts` on cancel/ready, even though `handlers/voice-log.ts` already returns the next-state values for those cases. Stale clarification state can leak into later logging flows.
